items.difficulty_reason: The lemma shows that the Gysin homomorphism attached to a triple descends from cycles to the Chow group (statement lines 5419-5427, tag 02TO). The proof is a real reduction: it unfolds rational equivalence into a locally finite sum of principal divisors, uses the compatibility of the Gysin map with the proper pushforward from the disjoint union of the components to reduce to an integral scheme with a single principal divisor, and then splits into the two cases according to whether the divisor is the whole scheme, in which case the first Chern class statement applies, or a proper divisor, in which case the Gysin pullback is a cap with the Chern class of the structure sheaf and therefore vanishes. The two-case analysis is the substance, so the claim is H2.
